commands.name: schema
commands.usage: Print the schema manifest, optionally filtered to one command

commands.name: completion
commands.usage: Print a shell completion script (ignores -o; always the raw script)

groups.desc: Authenticate with a Rancher server, manage API tokens, and inspect the session.
groups.name: auth

groups.desc: Manage local CLI configuration: server list, active context, credential store, editor, and shell completion.
groups.name: config

groups.desc: Install, remove, and check the agent skills that come with rancher-cli.
groups.name: skill

groups.desc: Control and inspect usage recording: status, turn on, turn off, delete, list and send events.
groups.name: telemetry

groups.desc: Create Rancher resources. Most commands in this group have their own flags for one kind; `rancher create resource -f <file|->` creates any kind `rancher schema` lists (one document per run; a few kinds must be created with their dedicated command, and the refusal names it).
groups.name: create

groups.desc: Manage a project's namespaces: add namespaces of the project's cluster to a Rancher project, or remove them from it.
groups.name: project

groups.desc: Manage OIDC client secrets for Rancher's embedded OIDC provider; `rancher create oidc-client` creates the client itself.
groups.name: oidc-client

groups.desc: Scale a machine pool, manage cluster-autoscaler settings, upgrade the Kubernetes version of a cluster, set its upgrade strategy, take an etcd snapshot or restore a cluster from one; to create or delete a provisioning cluster use `rancher create cluster` and `rancher delete provisioning-cluster`, and to read one use `rancher get provisioning-cluster`.
groups.name: cluster

groups.desc: Drain a node of a cluster or stop a running drain, through the management node Rancher keeps for it; Rancher runs the drain. Read nodes with `rancher get node --cluster <cluster>` and the drain state with `rancher get management-node --cluster <cluster>`.
groups.name: node

groups.desc: Show the current state, events and related objects of a cluster, workload or project.
groups.name: inspect

groups.desc: Questions about access, answered by the server: whether a subject can perform a verb on a resource, the rules a subject has in a namespace, which of the subjects named in the cluster's bindings the authorizer allows to perform a verb on a resource, why the authorizer decided as it did for one subject (the chain of Rancher bindings and templates behind the binding it accepted), which clusters Rancher's proxy lets a subject into, with the management bindings that grant that access, and which projects a subject can see into (the authorizer's answer to getting each namespace of the project, summarized per project), kept apart from the ProjectRoleTemplateBindings behind them. The authorizer questions are answered through the Rancher proxy by SubjectAccessReview, SelfSubjectAccessReview or SelfSubjectRulesReview; which clusters a subject can reach is the proxy's own answer; the bindings are only read, and the client never evaluates them.
groups.name: access

groups.desc: Get one resource by name, or list all of a kind. Generated for every kind `rancher schema` lists; `rancher get cloud-credential` and `rancher get kubernetes-versions` are dedicated commands.
groups.name: get

groups.desc: Install a chart from a ClusterRepo as an app, upgrade an app or uninstall one, through Rancher's catalog actions; list charts with `rancher charts` and read apps with `rancher get app`.
groups.name: app

groups.desc: Add one of the two Rancher extension repositories, list the Rancher UI extensions the ClusterRepos offer, and install, upgrade or uninstall an extension. The two repositories are the ClusterRepos the Rancher UI's Extensions page adds, partner-extensions on every server and rancher-ui-plugins on Rancher Prime.
groups.name: extension

commands.name: charts
commands.usage: List the charts and versions the repositories of a cluster offer

commands.name: grant
commands.usage: Grant a role to a user or group at project, cluster, or global scope

commands.name: revoke
commands.usage: Revoke a subject's role(s) at project, cluster, or global scope

commands.name: token
commands.usage: Legacy exec-credential shim for Rancher-generated kubeconfigs

commands.name: images
commands.usage: List container images in use, grouped by image or owning workload

commands.name: usage
commands.usage: Show CPU/memory requests, limits, and usage for namespaces, projects, nodes, or pods

commands.name: kubeconfig
commands.usage: Print an exec-credential kubeconfig for a cluster, with its direct endpoint contexts when the cluster has them

commands.name: logs
commands.usage: Show logs of Rancher components (server, agent, fleet-agent, kube-api-auth, webhook, api-extension)

commands.name: support-bundle
commands.usage: Collect diagnostics reachable through the API into one tar.gz for support

groups.desc: Apply a partial update to a resource from a patch file or stdin. Generated for every kind `rancher schema` lists. `rancher patch cloud-credential` is a dedicated command with its own flags.
groups.name: patch

groups.desc: Delete a resource by name. Generated for kinds that support deletion; some kinds add extra checks or cascade warnings. `rancher delete cloud-credential` is a dedicated command.
groups.name: delete
